Reproducible.description: The records may be republished, with the credit the terms ask.

NonCommercial.description: The records may be republished for non-commercial use only.

XRAY.description: Soft X-ray flare (e.g. event type XRA).

CUSTOM.description: A kind this enum does not model; EVENT_TYPE_CODE carries the source token.

SOURCE_ID.description:
Publisher-stable, lowercase identifier of the source in the provider's
registry of sources.

SOURCE_KIND.description: What kind of data the source supplies.

Ephemeris.description: Ephemerides: states over time, from an operator or a precise-orbit service

Observation.description: Observations (ranges, angles, other measurements) that states are estimated from

Reference.description: Reference registers of sites and facilities (status, dates, identity)

ORIGINATOR.description:
Agency, operator or catalog that created the source data, as it names
itself. Not a message's CCSDS ORIGINATOR, which names who created the
message.

PROVIDER_ID.description:
Identifier of the provider that published the product, as the provider
names itself: the module, node or service that retrieved the source data.

PRODUCER.description:
Identifier of the software that made the product from the source data,
with its version when it has one.

LICENSE_CLASS.description: What the source's terms permit for the product.

Unspecified.description: Not stated. Never a grant: treated as CiteOnly.

Reproducible.description: The records may be republished, with the credit the terms ask.

CiteOnly.description: The records are computed on and cited, never republished.

ShareAlike.description: The records may be republished under the same terms, which every derived record carries.

NonCommercial.description: The records may be republished for non-commercial use only.

LICENSE_ID.description:
Identifier of the terms LICENSE_CLASS was read from: an SPDX license
identifier where one applies, else the identifier of the terms in the
provider's licence register.

LINEAGE.description:
Identifier of the lineage the source's data descends from. Sources that
republish one upstream share its lineage, so their products are not
independent of each other.

EVENT_ID.description: The source's own event identity, verbatim.

UNSPECIFIED.description: Not stated. Ordinal 0 so an unset field is never read as a real kind.

XRAY.description: Soft X-ray flare (e.g. event type XRA).

CUSTOM.description: A kind this enum does not model; EVENT_TYPE_CODE carries the source token.

EVENT_TYPE_CODE.description: Source event type code, verbatim (e.g. XRA, FLA).

BEGIN_QUALIFIER.description: Qualifier on BEGIN_TIME, verbatim (e.g. B for before).

END_QUALIFIER.description: Qualifier on END_TIME, verbatim (e.g. A for after).

PASSBAND_MIN_NM.description: Lower edge of the observing passband in nm.

PASSBAND_MAX_NM.description: Upper edge of the observing passband in nm.

REGION_NUMBER.description: Associated region number; meaningful only when HAS_REGION_NUMBER.

HAS_REGION_NUMBER.description: True only when the source explicitly states the region association.

HG_LATITUDE_DEG.description: Heliographic latitude in degrees, north positive, when stated.

HG_LONGITUDE_DEG.description: Stonyhurst heliographic longitude in degrees, west positive, when stated.

STATUS.description: Source status of the report, verbatim.

REVISION.description: Source revision or change flag, verbatim.

PROVENANCE.description: Per-record source, provider, software, license terms and lineage.

SOURCE_CID.description: CID of the original source bytes this record was parsed from.

SOURCE_DIGEST.description: SHA-256 of the original source bytes, lowercase hex.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: When the source bytes were retrieved, RFC 3339 UTC.
